يستجليا (form X)
# يَسْتَجْلِيَا (yastajliyā) /jas.tad͡ʒ.li.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
# يُسْتَجْلَيَا (yustajlayā) /jus.tad͡ʒ.la.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
